name: PURITY SEALS
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Phobos operative shoots, fights or retaliates and its attack roll has two or more fails, discard one fail and keep another as a normal success.

name: ADDITIONAL UTILITY GRENADES
text: Pick four utility grenades (any mix of smoke and stun) instead of two. Cannot be taken with the universal Utility Grenades.

name: COMBAT BLADES
text: Every friendly Phobos operative carries a combat blade (Atk 5, Hit 3+, Dmg 3/4) for the battle.

name: SPECIAL ISSUE AMMUNITION
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Phobos operative takes a Shoot with a bolt carbine, marksman bolt carbine or occulus bolt carbine, that weapon has Piercing 1 until the end of the turning point.
